name: rclone-mcp-server

tools.name: operations_copyfile
tools.description:
Copy a single file — Copies one object from a source remote and path to a destination remote and path.

IMPORTANT: If this operation is expected to take a long time (more than a few seconds), you MUST set `_async: true` to run it in the background. It will return a `jobid` immediately, which you can poll using the `job_status` tool.

srcFs.description: Source remote name or path, such as `drive:` or `/` for the local filesystem.

srcRemote.description: Path to the source object within `srcFs`, for example `dir/file.txt`.

dstFs.description: Destination remote name or path, such as `drive2:` or `/` for local filesystem.

dstRemote.description: Target path within `dstFs` where the file should be written.

_group.description: Assign the request to a custom stats group.

_async.description: Run this operation asynchronously in the background. Highly recommended to set to true for long-running operations to avoid timeout.

tools.name: operations_deletefile
tools.description: Delete single file — Removes a specific object from the remote.

fs.description: Remote name or path that contains the file to delete.

remote.description: Exact path to the file within `fs` that should be deleted.

_group.description: Assign the request to a custom stats group.

_async.description: Run the command asynchronously. Returns a job id immediately.

tools.name: operations_movefile
tools.description:
Move a single file — Moves one object from a source remote and path to a destination remote and path.

IMPORTANT: If this operation is expected to take a long time (more than a few seconds), you MUST set `_async: true` to run it in the background. It will return a `jobid` immediately, which you can poll using the `job_status` tool.

srcFs.description: Source remote name or path containing the file to move.

srcRemote.description: Path to the source object within `srcFs`.

dstFs.description: Destination remote name or path where the file will be moved.

dstRemote.description: Destination path within `dstFs` for the moved object.

_group.description: Assign the request to a custom stats group.

_async.description: Run this operation asynchronously in the background. Highly recommended to set to true for long-running operations to avoid timeout.

tools.name: operations_size
tools.description:
Count remote size — Reports total size, file count, and number of objects without size metadata.

IMPORTANT: If this operation is expected to take a long time (more than a few seconds), you MUST set `_async: true` to run it in the background. It will return a `jobid` immediately, which you can poll using the `job_status` tool.

fs.description: Remote name or path to measure aggregate size information for.

_group.description: Assign the request to a custom stats group.

_async.description: Run this operation asynchronously in the background. Highly recommended to set to true for long-running operations to avoid timeout.

tools.name: core_stats
tools.description: Current stats snapshot — Returns active transfer statistics including bytes transferred, speed, and error counts.

group.description: Stats group identifier to return a snapshot for. Leave unset to include all groups.

short.description: When true, omit the `transferring` and `checking` arrays from the response.

_group.description: Assign the request to a custom stats group.

tools.name: rclone_lsjson
tools.description: List objects — Lists objects and directories for a remote path, returning the same fields as `rclone lsjson`.

fs.description: Remote name or path to list, for example `drive:`.

remote.description: Directory path within `fs` to list; leave empty to target the root.

opt.description: Optional JSON-encoded object of listing flags (e.g. `{ "recurse": true, "showHash": true }`).

recurse.description: Set to true to list directories recursively.

noModTime.description: Set to true to omit modification times for faster listings on some backends.

showEncrypted.description: Set to true to include encrypted names when using crypt remotes.

showOrigIDs.description: Set to true to include original backend identifiers where available.

showHash.description: Set to true to include hash digests for each entry.

noMimeType.description: Set to true to omit MIME type detection.

dirsOnly.description: Set to true to return only directory entries.

filesOnly.description: Set to true to return only file entries.

metadata.description: Set to true to include backend-provided metadata maps.

hashTypes.description: Specify one or more hash algorithms to include when `showHash` is true (e.g. `md5`).

_config.description: JSON encoded config overrides applied for this call only.

_filter.description: JSON encoded filter overrides applied for this call only.

_group.description: Assign the request to a custom stats group.

_async.description: Run the command asynchronously. Returns a job id immediately.

tools.name: operations_stat
tools.description: Stat an object — Returns metadata for a single file or directory, mirroring `rclone lsjson` on one entry.

fs.description: Remote name or path that contains the item to inspect.

remote.description: Path to the file or directory within `fs` to describe.

opt.description: Optional JSON object of listing flags, matching those accepted by `operations/list`.

_group.description: Assign the request to a custom stats group.

_async.description: Run the command asynchronously. Returns a job id immediately.
